Rubin's rules

Source: R/OncReg.imputation.R
OR.Rubin.Rd

Pools estimates and variances across multiply imputed datasets using Rubin's rules¹, with small-sample correction² for t-based complete-data analyses.

Usage

OR.Rubin(beta, SE, df.com = Inf)

Arguments

beta

Numeric vector of point estimates, one per imputed dataset.

SE

Numeric vector of standard errors, one per imputed dataset.

df.com

Complete-data degrees of freedom, e.g. df.residual() of a linear model; Inf for z-based models such as Cox. Default = Inf.

Value

A named numeric vector with the pooled estimate, standard error, 95% confidence limits, and two-sided p-value.

References

  1. Rubin, D.B., 1987. Multiple Imputation for Nonresponse in Surveys. New York: Wiley.

  2. Barnard, J. and Rubin, D.B., 1999. Small-sample degrees of freedom with multiple imputation. Biometrika, 86(4), pp. 948–955.

See also

Other imputation: OR.LOCF()
